remarks: Multi-family investment opportunity with off-street parking. This property offers rental potential. The 2 units in the main house have one furnace and one electrical panel and shares utilities. The unit above the garage has a separate furnace and electrical panel. Unit 1 features 1 bedroom, living room, kitchen and interior basement access. Unit 2 includes kitchen, 2 bedrooms and walk-up attic access with finishing potential. Unit 3 includes kitchen, 2 bedrooms, living room and garage access. Potential for laundry installation in the basement as there's exterior access. Walk-up attic offers finishing possibilities. Property has great potential and is sold as-is. Conveniently located to public transportation, shopping and major roadways.
